correctness.rationale: For a binary (n−r)-space ker H, diameter ≤n−2 iff its full-rank parity-check columns satisfy s=Σh_i≠0 and h_i≠s for each i (exclude all-ones and all-one-except-i words). For fixed nonzero s, finite-character orthogonality yields F_j(n)=((2^j−1)^n−ε_{j,n})/2^j on a j-space containing s, ε=1 for n even, 2^j−1 for n odd. Möbius inversion over subspaces containing s with Gaussian coefficients and division by free GL(r,2) action proves the claimed exact B_{n,r} for all n≥2,2≤r≤n. r=3 simplifies to (7^n−6·3^n+5)/192 for even n, +11 for odd; fixed-r rarity follows from the largest exponential base and Gaussian asymptotics. Independently enumerated all distinct binary RREF generator row spaces for n=2..7 and tested their actual maximum codeword weights for every r. The zero subspace when r=n is included; n<r and exact-diameter counts are outside scope.
